sample.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE CHLADNI SKYGARDEN. An invented inhabited celestial garden appears ONLY through flat CHLADNI-FIGURE SAND-NODAL RECORDINGS. VISUAL CONSTRUCTION: irregular MATTE IVORY and PALE OCHRE sand grains accumulate densely along broad CURVED NODAL RIDGES,forming connected branching/crossing loops and rounded cellular standing-wave patterns. Large transparent EMPTY INTERNODAL AREAS lie between those grain ridges. The recognisable whole organism/structure silhouette consists ONLY of those accumulated grain bands and a few broad densely grained nodal patches. There is NO solid body underneath and no surface coated with sand. Flat two-dimensional grain accumulation image,not shaded 3D matter. Broad ridge widths and a small number of large cells,roughly four to eight prominent cells across the main form. Each ridge has visible uneven discrete natural grains and slightly ragged margins;matte chalk-ivory centres and muted ochre edge grains,not glitter or light points. The entire body has empty optical gaps between the grain bands. Curves are not threads,wires or tubes. No smooth outline drawing,beaded/sewn regular chain,woven lace,fibres,metal,clay,stone,resin,fused glass,gloss,specular highlights or cast shadows. No 3D substrate,sand pile sculpture,opaque grain-textured skin,nebula haze,LiDAR point cloud,thin particle tracks,quiver arrows,checker cells or regular parallel stripes. The distinctive standing-wave nodal-grain network must be visible in the actual image. Fictional artistic ecology inspired by vibrating-plate grain patterns,not a measured experiment or a claim about acoustic propagation in vacuum. No text,numbers,labels,scale bar,axes,plot,clock,UI,reading,logo or watermark. Subject: ONE complete BELLPOD ARBOR: a small invented tree with one short thick forked trunk,THREE broad arching branches,and THREE unequal bell-shaped open seedpods hanging from those branches. Each pod is a wide downward-opening bell with a thick flared rim and one large open mouth;left pod low and broad,centre pod tall,right pod smaller and tipped outward. THREE broad root feet curl below the trunk. The trunk/branches/pod walls are made only of nodal-grain loops and broad grain ridges,with large open internodal spaces. Read as a useful living sky-garden plant,not a lampstand,wire sculpture or ordinary leafy tree. Whole pod rims,branch tips and root ends. Asset: ONE independent square1024x1024 pure-art widget. Real transparent alpha OUTSIDE the entire subject AND inside every internodal gap. No rectangular plate/background beneath the grains. Complete subject and each grain-built limb/leaf/pod/wing/roof/root/support endpoint safely inside central seventy percent with generous truly empty margins. Keep most grains close to the connected ridges,not scattered into the corners. No soil/floor patch,shadow,landscape,extra figures,frame,panel,contact sheet or device mockup. Broad nodal architecture and complete tangible silhouette legible at85px.

assessment: On actual proposed plum background,connected broad ivory/ochre grain bands leave large genuinely empty internodal cells through trunk/branches/pods/rootfeet. Distinct construction from B11solid sand-painted wall fields,C2thin tracks and C8depth point surfaces.
